subclaim: S4 (title): the drift of the error with the split draw is a property of the block hold-out, not of a domain almost empty of signal
origem: requested in the internal review of the manuscript; adopted on 04/10/2026 (item G2). Recorded in criteria/ before any script or result existed
pergunta: On a continuous target defined at every node and without a sentinel (terrain elevation of the cell), with the same 10 km blocks and the same 60 split draws of the 16 cells, does the MAE of the constant predictor drift between draws by a non-negligible fraction of its value, and is the block hold-out worth far fewer independent nodes than a simple random sample of the same size?
desenho: 16 cells; the same 60 split_seed of fase2/2.1_deriva_erro_baselines_16x60rnd.json (assertion equal to v3_13_laco_comum.py:88-94); g = 10 km, b = 2 km (primary) and b = 0 (secondary); partition by orig.split_espacial_3vias, unchanged. Primary target: y_i = features_raw[i, 0] (elevation normalised by cell). Primary predictor: FIXED constant c_ref = median of y over the training nodes of the reference draw (split seed 42, same rule as v3_12_R2_referencia_desenho.py:86-97). Secondary predictor: median of y over the training nodes of each draw (refit channel). Primary population: all nodes. Per draw: Err_sigma = mean of |y_i - c| over the retained test nodes; n_sigma = number of those nodes; sums S_B, M_B per test block (same function somas_por_bloco). Descriptive secondary readings: (i) b = 0; (ii) median per draw; (iii) elevation restricted to the valid RSSI nodes (Z_i = 0), the same population as the valid-node analysis of the article; (iv) NDVI (features_raw[:, 12]) under gate P4.

grandezas.CV_d: per cell: SD (ddof=1) of Err_sigma across the 60 draws divided by the mean of Err_sigma; decision statistic = median over the 16 cells (dimensionless, invariant to normalisation by cell)
grandezas.deff: per cell: Var_sigma(Err_sigma) (ddof=1) divided by the mean over draws of V_SRS(sigma) = (1 - n_sigma/N_U) * S2_U / n_sigma, with S2_U the variance (ddof=1) of |y_i - c_ref| over all nodes of the cell; closed form of simple random sampling without replacement of the same n, no Monte Carlo; n_ef = mean(n_sigma)/deff; decision statistic = median over the 16 cells
grandezas.razao_entre_celulas: mean over the 16 cells of the SD across draws divided by the SD between the cell means, in metres (y denormalised by elev_std of the cell); DESCRIPTIVE, with no role in the branches: for elevation the SD between cells measures the relief contrast between cities, not noise, and the ratio is not comparable to 8.02/2.18 dB of the target with sentinel

portoes_antes_de_ler.P1_coluna: per cell, mean of features_raw[:,0] in [-1e-3, 1e-3] and SD (ddof=0) in [0.999; 1.001] (the producer normalises by cell, generate_graph_v19.py:421-422,470-473); failure in any cell -> abort (wrong column)
portoes_antes_de_ler.P2_nan: zero NaN/inf in features_raw[:,0]; otherwise abort
portoes_antes_de_ler.P3_particao: n_test per draw equal to that of fase5/_parcial_laco/<cel>.json:por_sorteio[*].n_test in the 960 draws; otherwise abort
portoes_antes_de_ler.P4_ndvi: share of nodes with features_raw[:,12] == 0 exactly; if > 1 %, the NDVI leaves the reading (record only)
portoes_antes_de_ler.P5_controle_negativo: same computation with the elevation permuted among the nodes of the cell (np.random.default_rng(20261004 + cell_index)), spatially white target: the median of deff must fall in [0.5; 2]; outside that range the run is invalid and there is no reading

limiares_e_justificativa.A: median(CV_d) >= 0.05. A standard deviation of 5 % of the value itself changes the second significant digit of an MAE reported with two digits; and it is one order of magnitude below the coefficient of the target with sentinel at the valid nodes (computable from the fields of fase5/_parcial_laco; not consulted to fix the threshold)
limiares_e_justificativa.B: median(deff) >= 10. Under simple random sampling deff = 1 by definition; deff < 10 means that the block draw inflates the SD of the reported error by less than sqrt(10) ~ 3.2 times that of a simple random sample of the same size, negligible with n of 10^5 to 10^6 nodes; the target with sentinel has deff of the order of 10^4 (record index V.<cel>.<pred>.<pop>.deff), so 10 is a conservative floor

leitura: Branches on elevation, fixed constant, all nodes, b = 2 (full partition of the A x B plane): A true -> REINFORCES S4/title (the drift appears on a continuous target without sentinel; the text gains one sentence in the drift section and the limitation 'all the evidence comes from cells dominated by sentinel' is removed). A false and B true -> DELIMITS (the variance remains governed by the blocks, as the designvar proposition predicts, but is small on a smooth continuous target; the magnitude figures of the article, 8.0 dB and 1 to 5 nodes, become conditional on targets whose loss varies at the block scale, like the sentinel fixed by the range; the abstract and the introduction state the condition; the title stays). A false and B false -> INVERTS (the block hold-out behaves like simple random sampling on a target without sentinel; the measured drift is a property of the sentinel). The secondary readings (b = 0, median per draw, valid RSSI nodes, NDVI) are reported with the same numbers and do not change the branch; a disagreement of the NDVI becomes one clause.
se_inverter: returns to the authors the title and scope of S4: 'Estimand Drift under Spatial Block Hold-Out' would hold only for targets dominated by sentinel/imputation, and the decision to reformulate title, abstract and introduction belongs to the authors
orcamento: CPU, no GPU and no training; basis: the loop recorded tempo_total_s of 233 to 292 s per cell for 60 draws at b = 2 (fase5/_parcial_laco/<cel>.json); with b = 0, negative control and secondary targets, an estimate of ~8 min per cell, ~130 min of CPU, ~35-45 min of wall-clock with 4 processes as in the loop; plus ~16 x 10 s of mmap reading of <city>_v19_<Q>_gpu.pt if the ratio in metres is requested
fixado_por: fixed by decision of 04/10/2026 ('run'); text of the criterion = draft of the internal physics-mathematics review, unchanged apart from this field and fixado_em
